summary: Practicing attorney with 10 years of experience in commercial litigation and transactional matters, licensed and in good standing with a state bar since 2016. Proven record managing complex cases from inception through resolution and advising clients on regulatory compliance and contract negotiations.

experience.title: Senior Litigation Associate
bullets: Manage a portfolio of 30+ commercial litigation matters, including contract disputes, tort claims, and employment actions, with cumulative exposure exceeding $15M.
Lead discovery strategy, depose fact and expert witnesses, and argue dispositive motions in state and federal courts.
Second-chair two jury trials and negotiate favorable settlements in approximately 85% of mediated cases.
Supervise two junior associates and a paralegal, reviewing pleadings and providing mentorship on case strategy.

experience.title: Transactional Associate
bullets: Drafted and negotiated asset purchase agreements, shareholder agreements, and commercial leases for small and mid-sized businesses.
Advised clients on entity formation, corporate governance, and regulatory compliance matters across multiple industries.
Conducted legal due diligence for mergers and acquisitions ranging from $1M to $20M in transaction value.
Collaborated with tax and finance professionals to structure deals and close transactions on schedule.

education.degree: Bachelor of Arts in Political Science
